label: copy-phase input k near the start of the copy (mostly echoed first token k)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and only when the fed-back input is the letter k (99% of mass; a trace on v). 84% of mass is at recall_idx 1, where the input k is the echoed first original token (first_tok k); 15% is at recall_idx 2. It never fires in the original or delimiter phases, on first occurrences of a token, or on any other letter or digit. Precision is low (about 12%): most early copy-phase k inputs do not activate it, and no simple variable separates the ones that do. Magnitude is largest when the sequence is short, starts with k k (so the next output is also k), and has no digits; the top examples are k k r ... <DEL> [k]. Conditioning on out_tok k or in_count >= 2 raises precision to 0.3-0.4 but loses most of the recall.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: recall_idx=1 & in_tok=k (+7.24), phase=2 & out_tok=k (+5.63), phase=2 & out_tok=v (+4.58), phase=2 & in_tok=k (+3.78), orig0=v (+3.01), orig3=r (+2.41). Lower it: next_out=- (-3.23), out_tok=0 (-2.90), orig2=0 (-2.86), orig1=x (-2.48).
